# Dear ImGui

Dear ImGui 1.92.2 (https://github.com/ocornut/imgui, tag v1.92.2), MIT licence in `LICENSE.txt`. Source of the copy: the release archive
`https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/archive/refs/tags/v1.92.2.zip`, SHA-256 `8d3398f35ab9c9cf49ccc0516624f086f4242d979e82eacdf83822ce2558d0cb`.

Only what the launcher's SDL3 backend needs, unmodified: the core (`imgui*.cpp`, `imgui*.h`, `imstb_*.h`, `imconfig.h`) and the SDL3 platform
and SDL renderer backends (`backends/`). The demo window and the other backends are left out.
